name: Marchena (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Marchena (a saltire of arrows on white within an ornate frame, with a lion and the bars of Aragon).
history: Municipal flag of Marchena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
